key: They who are free from death, fain for him, purified three splendours of the mighty Agni, circling all. To man, for his enjoyment, one of these they gave: the other two have passed into the sister sphere.
s: Hailing Agni as Vaisvanara, High Priest of the Gods, the hymn praises his threefold fire; Sāyaṇa, on 3.2.9, reads the three as his earthly, lightning and solar forms, the earthly one set among mortals, or else as the rite’s three fuel sticks.
src: Sāyaṇa, Vedārthaprakāśa, on Rig Veda 3.2.9, sa.wikisource (printed edition not named), revision 315134 (2021)

opened.locator: 3.2.9 and its note on tisrah samidhah

evidence.words: समिधः समिंधिकाः प्रकाशिकास्तिस्रः पार्थिववैद्युतसूर्यरूपास्तिस्रस्तनूरपुनन्। अशोधयन् । ते देवा भुजं सर्वेषां पालयित्री तासां तनूनां मध्य एकां पार्थिवीं तनुं मर्त्ये मर्त्यलोकेऽदधुः । न्यदधुः । उ इति पादपूरणः । इतरे द्वे तनू जामिं लोकमासन्नमंतरिक्षमुपेयतुः । गच्छतः । अथवा तिस्रः समिध आघारसमिधौ द्वे अनूयाजसमिच्चैकेति।
evidence.gloss: The three kindlers, the illuminators: his three bodies in the form of the earthly, the lightning and the solar fire, they purified. Of those bodies they placed one, the earthly body, among mortals, in the world of mortals. The other two bodies went to the neighbouring world, the mid-air. Or else: the three fuel sticks, the two āghāra sticks and the one anūyāja stick.

reason: Both problems hold. (1) The context clause used 'the hymn turns to'; replaced with the critic's 'the hymn praises his threefold fire', which is the verse's own act (the immortals purified Agni's three splendours) in words not taken from it. (2) 'Sāyaṇa, commentary on 3.2.9,' now reads 'Sāyaṇa, on 3.2.9,' as the rest of the batch, and the src gains 'on' (Vedārthaprakāśa, on Rig Veda 3.2.9). Reading unchanged and re-found in packet.js veda 32 --verse 3.2.9: pārthivavaidyutasūryarūpās tisras tanūḥ, the earthly body placed martye martyaloke, the other two to the mid-air, athavā the two āghāra and one anūyāja sticks; Wilson's note reports both. verse.js ok (Rig Veda 3.2.9, at [235,9]); entry-check ok, no warns.
